title: Ninjato swords
description: Adds Ninjato Swords to your game!
body:
Ninjato swords - resource pack for minecraft **1.20+**

With this resource pack, all vanilla swords are replaced with custom models and textures.!
After installing the pack, your swords will have a Ninjatō-inspired appearance. 
The textures are carefully designed to match the style of Minecraft's vanilla armor.![All swords with all armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99f622955fa0c2bfdb698e7e8bc7d47790620f6c_0.webp)

Ninjato Swords – Become a Ninja!
